title: Mixed Event — Resonating with you — Episode8 Please, Reach Them!

meta.Event Outline: Ichika and the others learn that Shiho has been scouted by another band. Shiho is finally able to express what she's been feeling, but how will her bandmates respond?

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
Hm? What's going on?
I thought only STANDOUT was playing today?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hello, everyone!
We're Leo/need! It's great to see you here!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Today, we'll be the opening performance for STANDOUT's big show.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We'd like to play the song that brought us together as a band, and hope that you'll listen...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Oh no, my hands are starting to shake...!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (This is totally different from doing a street performance. I can't tell if my voice is reaching them...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Everyone else sounds so far away for some reason too...)

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: You'd think STANDOUT would have a better opening act, right?

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
They sound pretty amateurish.
Not really getting our money's worth...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (How can Iori do this to them? Making them perform in public for the first time on this big a stage...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Everyone's starting to freeze up too. It feels like they're letting the audience control the agenda...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (We won't be able to recover if this keeps up...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (It's our first show as Leo/need too...! It's our chance to tell Shiho how we truly feel...!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (We can't give up! We need to tell her...!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (This song, this performance has to reach her!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Right, I need to keep up with her...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I'm the pillar that supports this band.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(Ichi...! Hona...! They sound amazing!
Way better than they do in practice...!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (We have to get through this song and tell Shiho how we really feel...!)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Ichika got Honami and Saki to bounce back... They never had this kind of power during practice...!)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(They are serious...
It's so easy to tell...)

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
Yeah! That's more like it!
Who were they again?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I was nervous at first, but that went really well!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I didn't know you could sing like that.
It was incredible...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And you two did really well too, Saki, Honami. Especially considering this was your first show.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. I made a couple mistakes, but doing a show with you like this was so much fun...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm sorry for making you wait all this time. You're not alone anymore...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're serious about trying to go pro?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Don't come crying to me if anything happens.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Let's make our dreams come true, as Leo/need!

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: I guess that makes me the loser...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: (If only she could say the same thing. No, she might not be ready yet...)

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Well, time to scout a new member.

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: I'm sorry for avoiding you this whole time. I was so scared about what would happen after we went pro...

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: But I'm ready. I'm done running. I'll do everything I can for this band, so please, let me come back...!

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: I deserve some of the blame too, but do you know how much trouble you caused us and the staff?

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: I'm so sorry. I really am...

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: But I want us to perform together. I know that I was being selfish, but I want us to keep playing as STANDOUT!

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
Thanks for waiting, everyone!!
Now, let's get this show started!!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Get ready for some tough practices starting tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Uh oh!
Here come Shiho the tyrant!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Let's keep practicing and work towards putting on another show.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But we'll have to start making our own songs too if we're gonna actually go pro. Just keep that in mind.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, you're right! We'll have to start thinking about that...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Our own songs...!
I bet Shiho can come up with some without even trying!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If only it were so easy...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But we can all think about that together...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Right. Let's make as many as we can.
The four of us, together!
